{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lovely Carrion Flightknife hangar''' was a base inside the [[Cartann City Air Base]] on the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cartann City|Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. It was where four [[Blade-32 superiority fighter|Blade-32's]] were awaiting [[Red Flight]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], after they finished the first part of the [[Gauntlet of Red Flight|gauntlet]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
